searches.note: Searched the complete xml query result subset; any bin.?xml match necessarily contains xml.

conclusion: No published module metadata matched axml, resxml, arsc or aapt in this fetched registry snapshot. The five Android metadata matches describe JNI, AOA, WASI hosting, a raylib Android-app template, and mobile UI. Binary/XML matched Apple property lists; binxml matched Windows Event Log BINXML; apk matched Alpine Linux packages. No direct Android binary XML decoder library or CLI was identified in the searched metadata and reviewed candidate READMEs.
limitations: Registry metadata search does not search package source code or private or unpublished projects.
Package descriptions may omit Android or AXML terminology; a zero match count is not proof that no implementation exists.
Registry contents may change after fetched_at.
The SHA-256 is for the complete decoded response body re-encoded as UTF-8; the raw HTTP transfer encoding is not persisted.
GitHub README review is a scope check, not an exhaustive audit of every candidate source file. The Android raylib template could only be classified by package name.

primary_source_checks.finding: Apple binary/XML property lists; a different format from Android AXML.
Linux packaging; README identifies apk as Alpine Linux packages.
Windows Event Log EVTX and Microsoft BINXML; a different format from Android AXML.
Java/MoonBit JNI runtime and Android lifecycle/Surface/main-Looper adapter.
Android Open Accessory protocol state machine and transports.
Android WASI host for running MoonBit guests with bounded USB capabilities.
MoonBit UI rendered through React Native.
README documents parsing XML strings, including elements, attributes, comments and CDATA.
README documents text HTML/XML/SVG parsing, tree queries, mutation and serialization.
Registry name indicates an Android raylib application template; metadata description and repository URL are empty; browser page had no readable content.
